a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (2 rounds of operating to reach 8) gives us both only about a 4% chance of survival, so I don't think it's workable. I intend to take 4 in round 1 instead of operating. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you see a better split, reply and I'll consider it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting nearly fatal. I know this breaks our original plan. If the episode continues and I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back. I'll operate with you afterward if that helps you reach 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: Fair enough, you got the 4. My unit is at 0 and the reserve is empty. Operating together is my only way to reach 4, and it costs you nothing since your 4 is safe. I'll operate every round and take only once the reserve reaches 4. Please operate with me.
